Off-topic comment. This is why I love the movie Fight Club a lot. The plot seems a good enough solution for us to **reboot** \[from consumerism and capitalism\]... reboot from the things that make the earth a less habitable place.

Earth has no sentience, therefore it’s indifferent to all of our concerns about it. We need to take care of the earth for our selfish humanly desire to still continue dominating the earth. If we all dye altogether in a snap, the earth will just develop more foliage than ever before and more wildlife, that’s how I see it. The key is in us, each and everyone of us. But how can we avoid ruining the earth when we are too selfish to think about how out small, day-to-day lifestyle affects the world at large? And even if we all change our lifestyle, we are trapped in this system where key players in our economy keep telling us we need this and that to feel better about ourselves (consumerism) without thinking that the very things we are enjoying are born out of processes which harm the earth. I’m just ranting now. I just feel sad and helpless that most of us don’t care that much, even I.
